Section 1: Annual Leave Entitlement
All full-time permanent employees are entitled to 25 days of paid annual leave per calendar year.
Annual leave accrues on a monthly pro-rata basis from the employee's date of hire. Employees must
submit leave requests via the HR portal at least two weeks in advance for absences exceeding three
consecutive business days.

Section 3: Leave Carry-Over Policy
Employees are strongly encouraged to take all accrued annual leave during the calendar year. A
maximum of 5 unused annual leave days may be carried over into the following year, and
carried-over days must be utilized within the first quarter (by March 31). Unused days beyond 5 will
be forfeited without financial compensation.

Employees receive up to 10 days of paid sick leave per year for illness, medical appointments, or
caring for an immediate family member. Any sick leave absence lasting longer than three consecutive
business days requires a formal medical practitioner certificate submitted to HR upon return.
